title: What radiofrequency microneedling actually does beneath the skin
summary: A closer look at how devices like Morpheus8 work, and who they are genuinely suited to.
body:
Radiofrequency microneedling works by combining two mechanisms in one device: fine needles that create a controlled injury response, and radiofrequency energy delivered beneath the surface to remodel tissue.

The result is a treatment that can address surface concerns like texture and pore size, and structural concerns like laxity, in the same course, which is why it sits in both families on this site.

Because the energy is delivered at a controlled depth, treatment is usually planned as a course rather than a single session, with results building gradually as the skin remodels collagen over the following months.
